subject.title: feat(feeds): choose publisher feeds from signed profiles

question: Should OpenClaw core own publisher following as a persistent gateway service with shared SQLite state, recurring network refresh, CLI commands, and Control UI management?
rationale: The implementation is not a narrow bug fix; it creates a new long-lived core product and trust surface that repository policy does not let automation accept without owner intent.

options.title: Sponsor the core stack
options.body: Approve publisher following as a first-class core capability after the protocol, stack-isolation, upgrade, security, and real-proof gates are satisfied.

options.title: Keep discovery external
options.body: Move publisher following and refresh into a plugin or ClawHub-owned package, adding only a generic core seam if the current plugin API proves insufficient.

options.title: Pause the proposal
options.body: Leave the drafts unlanded until the publisher-feed product contract, lifecycle, and ownership model are specified.

recommendation.title: Sponsor the core stack
recommendation.body: Approve publisher following as a first-class core capability after the protocol, stack-isolation, upgrade, security, and real-proof gates are satisfied.

likelyOwner.reason: This is a repository-wide product and ownership choice spanning gateway protocol, persistent state, networking, CLI, and Control UI rather than an isolated implementation repair.
